name: Triage
job: Bugs, alerts and security warnings sorted by how far they reach, each with an owner
intro: Reports come in from your app, your Lemma, Slack, GitHub, a report form, Sentry, PostHog and GitHub's security alerts. Each becomes one item, counted in people, with a suggested owner and the reason. One key decides it; everyone who asked is told when it's fixed.
does: Three reports of one problem, from a form, Slack and an error tracker, become one item, ranked by the people it reaches.
A suggested owner with the reason: your rules, CODEOWNERS, the last change to the line, or whoever is on triage.
Accept makes a team task with the evidence; give it to an agent; decline tells the askers why.

accounts.why: One shared GitHub connection: issues, +1 comments and security alerts on the repositories you pick, CODEOWNERS and the last change to a file for owners, and a comment when it's filed and fixed.
Reads the channels you watch for reports, and replies in the thread when it's fixed. The same app as your Lemma's bot.
Errors counted in people, read every 15 minutes; a Sentry issue is resolved when its task is done.

setup: Once for the whole Lemma: the repositories to watch, who's on triage, and any Slack channels, Sentry projects and PostHog project.
Or look around with a sample morning: a checkout crash reported four ways, a billing spike, two security alerts.
Turn on the report form and share its link, or put it in your product.
